description: A simple repeating work/break timer (like 90/20 ultradian rhythm): set work and break lengths and it cycles automatically with a chime.

faqs.q: How is this different from a Pomodoro timer?
faqs.a: It is simpler: one work length and one break length repeating forever, with no long-break cycle. Ideal for ultradian rhythms like 90 minutes on / 20 off.
Research suggests the brain works well in ~90-minute focus cycles followed by ~20-minute breaks. The defaults reflect that pattern.

faqs.q: Does it stay accurate in a background tab?
faqs.a: Yes — timing is driven by wall-clock timestamps, not tick counting.

howto: Set your work minutes and break minutes (defaults 90 / 20).
Press Start — the timer alternates Work → Break → Work automatically.
A chime sounds on every switch; the cycle counter tracks completed rounds.
Pause any time, or Reset to start fresh.
title: Work / Break Timer
